source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Citation repair on the ten cards read at the issuer on 2026-08-17. No reward rate, cap, fee or point value was changed. What changed is what the file CLAIMS to have proved: 33 numbers whose cited sentence did not establish them lost their citation or their 'high' confidence, 29 card-level fetch dates were corrected from the write-time clock to the date sources.json says the bytes were read, and four exclusion rows were removed. Two of those four (mcc:5816 on both Tata Neu cards) took Steam, PlayStation Store and Xbox from 1.5%/1.0% to zero for a sentence about Online Skill-Based Gaming; the other two excluded nothing another row on the same card did not already exclude, while still demoting the card on the engine's exclusion-count tie-break. Nothing here is issuer re-verification: it is the removal of claims the evidence on disk does not support.
